gpus.name: Intel UHD 630 / HD 630 (Coffee / Comet / Kaby)
gpus.notes: Works on 7th–10th Gen desktops with a matching ig-platform-id from the CPU profile.

gpus.name: Intel HD 4600 / 530 (Haswell / Skylake)
gpus.notes: Haswell HD 4600 needs the desktop framebuffer from the Haswell profile. Skylake HD 530 is broadly supported.

gpus.name: Intel UHD 730 / 750 / 770 (12th+)

bootArgs.reason: Disable the unsupported iGPU so a discrete AMD card can drive the display.

gpus.notes: No native macOS drivers. Pair with a supported AMD dGPU.

gpus.name: AMD RX 460 / 470 / 480 / 570 / 580 / 590 (Polaris)
gpus.notes: Most reliable AMD family in macOS. No extra boot-args required for typical desktops.

gpus.name: AMD Vega 56 / 64 / VII / Frontier
gpus.notes: Native. Some boards need agdpmod=pikera if the display blanks after the picker.

gpus.name: AMD RX 5500 / 5600 / 5700 (Navi 10 / 14)

bootArgs.reason: Bypasses AGDP board-id checks on Navi so the display initializes.

gpus.notes: Supported through Sequoia with WhateverGreen + agdpmod=pikera.

gpus.name: AMD RX 6600 / 6800 / 6900 (Navi 21 / 23)

bootArgs.reason: Required for Navi 21/23 to get past the Apple board-id check.

gpus.notes: Best current discrete choice. Do not use NootRX on these cards.

gpus.name: AMD RX 6700 / 6750 XT (Navi 22)

bootArgs.reason: Sometimes still needed depending on connector / WhateverGreen usage.

gpus.notes: Needs NootRX. WhateverGreen conflicts and must stay off.

gpus.name: AMD RX 6400 / 6500 XT (Navi 24)
gpus.notes: No usable macOS acceleration path. Pick another GPU.

gpus.name: AMD RX 7600 / 7700 / 7800 / 7900 (RDNA3)
gpus.notes: No OpenCore/macOS support. Do not target these cards.

gpus.name: AMD Ryzen APU (Vega / RDNA2 iGPU)
gpus.notes: Use NootedRed and keep WhateverGreen disabled.

gpus.name: NVIDIA Kepler (GTX 650–780 / Titan)
gpus.notes: Native only through High Sierra (10.13). Newer macOS dropped Kepler.

gpus.name: NVIDIA Maxwell / Pascal (GTX 900 / 10 series)

bootArgs.reason: Used with NVIDIA Web Drivers on High Sierra / Mojave only.

gpus.notes: Web Drivers stop at Mojave. Not a Sequoia/Sonoma target.

gpus.name: NVIDIA Turing / Ampere / Ada (RTX 20/30/40)
gpus.notes: No macOS drivers. Use AMD for any current target OS.
